note: SEALED: hidden information. Read by demo_v1 (Part B).

regret.definition: dose used / true minimal dose of the same protocol (det = noise-free bisection from the first-action state; noisy = median of per-key thresholds over 10 CRN keys)

mechanism.MA: memory-ligand A secretion (u_A on lit cells; enters only neighbours' paracrine sensing)
mechanism.MB: memory-ligand B secretion (u_B on lit cells)
mechanism.SEC: structural-signal secretion (adds to the cell's emitted type code c)
mechanism.RG: receptor gain (scales the sensed field lambda)
mechanism.MIG: migration gain (scales the movement rate k_a)
